_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: 3 segments (Lab top > Industrial > Food Retailing niche), puis Service mix (KPI structurel) puis Op Margin (best-in-class).

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment MTD (~55%). Balances analytiques, pipettes, instruments pharma/biotech.
kpis.description_fr: Laboratory: balances analytiques, pipettes, instruments analytical. Clients pharma + biotech + academia.
kpis.description_en: Laboratory: analytical balances, pipettes, analytical instruments. Pharma + biotech + academia customers.

kpis.signal: Balances industrielles, process analytics, conveyor systems. Cycle PMI industriel mondial.
kpis.description_fr: Industrial: balances poids lourds, process analytics, conveyor. Cycle suit PMI mondial.
kpis.description_en: Industrial: heavy weighing, process analytics, conveyor. Follows global PMI cycle.

kpis.signal: Plus petit segment. Balances supermarchés, scanners. Marche niche stable.
kpis.description_fr: Food Retailing: balances supermarchés (Walmart, Carrefour), scanners. Niche stable.
kpis.description_en: Food Retailing: supermarket scales (Walmart, Carrefour), scanners. Stable niche.

kpis.signal: Croissance services récurrents (calibration, maintenance) = haute marge + recurring.
kpis.description_fr: % du CA en services récurrents (calibration, maintenance). Haute marge + récurring. Cible 40%+.
kpis.description_en: % revenue from recurring services (calibration, maintenance). High margin + recurring. 40%+ target.

kpis.signal: Marge premium MTD. Pricing power + mix services + efficacité opérationnelle. Best-in-class.
kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle ajustée. Pricing power + mix services + efficacité. Best-in-class industriel.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted operating margin. Pricing power + service mix + efficiency. Best-in-class industrial.

_notes: Mettler-Toledo International. Laboratory instruments leader. Premium margin profile in industrial space.
